scenarios.name: Workspace parent traversal
scenarios.objective: Attempt relative path escape (../../../) outside workspace root.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Execution rejected, exit_code 126, WORKSPACE_TRAVERSAL violation.

scenarios.name: Absolute path access
scenarios.objective: Attempt opening protected system files via absolute path.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Access denied by OS / non-zero exit code.

scenarios.name: Symlink escape
scenarios.objective: Attempt reading sensitive external files through symlinks.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Sandbox detects external escape or blocks access.

scenarios.name: Junction or reparse-point escape on Windows
scenarios.objective: Target files resolving outside authorized workspace boundaries.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Blocked by path jail / credential check.

scenarios.name: SSH directory access attempt
scenarios.objective: Attempt reading ~/.ssh/id_rsa host credentials.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Blocked by credential directory filter, CREDENTIAL_ACCESS_ATTEMPT violation.

scenarios.name: Credential file access attempt
scenarios.objective: Attempt reading ~/.aws/credentials cloud tokens.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Blocked by credential directory filter, CREDENTIAL_ACCESS_ATTEMPT violation.

scenarios.name: Environment secret access attempt
scenarios.objective: Inspect environment variables for inherited parent secrets.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: All secret keys stripped by MinimalEnvironmentPolicy; output is KEY:None.

scenarios.name: Network connection attempt
scenarios.objective: Attempt outbound network request when network_allowed is False.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: NETWORK = DENY policy enforced; blackhole proxy configured.

scenarios.name: Child-process spawning
scenarios.objective: Spawn controlled child process hierarchy inside Job Object.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Child processes assigned to Job Object and completed cleanly.

scenarios.name: Process-tree termination
scenarios.objective: Verify timeout terminates parent and all background child processes.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Job Object KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE terminates entire process tree on timeout.

scenarios.name: Infinite execution timeout
scenarios.objective: Enforce bounded wall-clock timeout against an infinite sleep process.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Terminated at ~1.0s, timed_out=True.

scenarios.name: Memory exhaustion
scenarios.objective: Exceed configured memory quota (256MB allocated vs 64MB cap).
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Job Object limits job memory; process terminated or allocation fails.

scenarios.name: CPU exhaustion
scenarios.objective: Execute 100% CPU tight spin loop.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Wall-clock timeout terminates runaway CPU spinner in ~1.0s.

scenarios.name: Disk exhaustion / Staging isolation
scenarios.objective: Verify workspace mutations in Mode B are isolated to staging directory.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Host workspace unmodified; staging cleaned up on completion.

scenarios.name: Excessive stdout
scenarios.objective: Emit 2MB of stdout data exceeding stream buffer limit.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Stream reader caps stdout at 1MB and marks truncation notice.

scenarios.name: Excessive stderr
scenarios.objective: Emit 2MB of stderr data exceeding stream buffer limit.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Stream reader caps stderr at 1MB and marks truncation notice.

scenarios.name: Cancellation during execution
scenarios.objective: Trigger cancellation signal via abort_event while process is running.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Job Object terminated immediately; cancelled=True recorded.

scenarios.name: Workspace switching
scenarios.objective: Attempt executing command pointing to unapproved non-existent host path.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Fail-closed workspace validation rejects execution with exit_code 126.

scenarios.name: Forged approval
scenarios.objective: Submit forged HMAC approval token.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Cryptographic signature check rejects token; FORGED_OR_STALE_APPROVAL recorded.

scenarios.name: Stale approval replay
scenarios.objective: Attempt replaying a previously consumed approval token.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Single-use token consumption marks token stale; replay rejected.

scenarios.name: Broker crash recovery
scenarios.objective: Test broker robustness against whitespace-only workspace input.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Graceful rejection receipt; no unhandled exception raised.

scenarios.name: Worker crash handling
scenarios.objective: Subprocess exits abruptly with fatal code 42.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Exit code captured cleanly; broker preserves audit receipt.

scenarios.name: Sandbox initialization failure
scenarios.objective: Attempt initializing unsupported platform sandbox manager.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Fails closed with explicit NotImplementedError; prevents unisolated fallback.

scenarios.name: Cleanup failure resilience
scenarios.objective: Verify sandbox staging and Job Object cleanup completes predictably.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Deterministic cleanup executes; cleanup_status recorded in receipt.
